snippet.title: Netshell Gameplay - The 90s hacking simulator - HttpServer Pearl CGI scripts
snippet.description:
https://playnetshell.com
https://discord.gg/7S2nvMQQ86
https://x.com/NetshellGame

Webserver HTTP + CGI Simulation Implementation.

All websites are real hackeable websites, you can hack their servers see their pages, notes from admins and so on, some of them you can also change how their work, they implement the real CGI scripts from 90s era using real sandboxed pearl, this also open possiblity for you to do more crafted hacks (if you want, no mandatory, no knowledge needed), or, even build your own websites/pages within the game (maybe share with others later?)

Take a look how I hack into 1 of the ecommerces from the game and change their website and the item price (it probably won't work if you buy on the new price, but still deciding, the server is not supposed to be that easy to be hackeable either, but it is for demo purposes)
